text:
You need an ads specialist who can build Facebook and TikTok campaigns for telecom clients, speak to Israeli audiences, and report clearly on performance.  

I’m Mina Castellan, with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. While my background is on the analytics side rather than ad buying, I can help you turn campaign data into clear, actionable decisions.  

In my Marketing attribution analysis project for Verdant Skincare, I joined ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit. That work led to 18% of the ad budget being reallocated and customer acquisition cost dropping 12% the next quarter.  

If you’re open to it, how are you currently tracking Facebook and TikTok campaign performance for your telecom clients?
